name: Libertalia
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to choose 1 exhausted planet you control. Ready that planet and either repair each of your damaged mechs, or place 2 infantry on that planet.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: Long thought a myth, the pirate utopia of Libertalia has been sought after by many a mutineer for millenia.
